recognize_zh: 高倍下可見三個大型母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，左側細胞的細胞質較多呈淡藍色並有淡染區；t(8;21) AML 的經典線索是核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof）與單一細長尖端的 Auer 小體，但此圖中 Auer 小體並不明確。
features: Large blasts with round nuclei and finely granular, open chromatin
High N:C ratio in two cells; left blast has more abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm with a paler zone adjacent to the nucleus
Faint linear streaking in the left blast cytoplasm, possibly representing a slender Auer rod, not definitively resolved
Background red cells with some overlap/rouleaux-like stacking
describe_en: High-power view of a smear shows three large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. The left blast has a moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm with a paler juxtanuclear zone and faint linear cytoplasmic streaking that may correspond to a slender Auer rod; however, a discrete Auer rod is not clearly demonstrated at this focus and resolution. No maturing granulocytes are present in this field for assessment of dysplasia. Findings are consistent with myeloblasts and, in conjunction with cytogenetic confirmation, with acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21).

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm, no hof or Auer rods, and are MPO negative.
Shows bilobed nuclei, heavy granulation, and multiple Auer rods in bundles rather than a single long slender rod.
Blasts often have cup-like nuclear invaginations and lack the long single Auer rod and salmon-colored granules typical of t(8;21).
